# rotational_moulding
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
ROTATIONAL MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  materialFamily: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  wallThicknessMm=3  [ray-cast mean wall over 400 samples — deterministic, use verbatim]
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  heatTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  coolTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  coolingMethod: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  numArms: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  partsPerArm: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  projectedAreaCm2=768  [two largest bounding-box dimensions — deterministic, use verbatim]
  mouldType: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  mouldCostGBP: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
  mouldLife: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (HDPE | PP Homopolymer (MFI 12))
